page.overview:
Who is Greeble?

Greeble is a non-player character in two titles of the Chocobo series.

Greeble works under Irma as one of her lieutenants of sorts. He considers himself to be the brain to Peekaboo's brawn, but both of them are considered to be laughably incompetent by Volg.
